boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Oklahoma State University
boards.description: Ten currently documented, under-21-safe food destinations in Stillwater with evening or overnight availability.

cards.title: IHOP
cards.subtitle: 611 N Main St, Stillwater
cards.notes: Use the all-hours option when a late meal needs to fit an unpredictable schedule. Confirm service details before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour Stillwater dining room and takeout option.
cards.evidence_claim: IHOP’s official Stillwater page lists the restaurant as open 24 hours every day.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists restaurant hours as open 24 hours Monday through Sunday.

cards.title: Whataburger #577
cards.subtitle: 1001 N Boomer Rd, Stillwater
cards.notes: Keep this Boomer Road location in mind for a late pickup or drive-through stop. Check the location page for holiday exceptions.
cards.short_summary: An official 24-hour Whataburger location north of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Whataburger’s official Stillwater locator lists location #577 at 1001 N Boomer Road as open 24 hours daily.
cards.access_notes: Official locator lists the location as open 24 hours each day and notes holiday hours may differ.

cards.title: McDonald's on West McElroy
cards.subtitle: 110 W McElroy Rd, Stillwater
cards.notes: Choose the drive-through for an overnight option near the campus area. The dining room has earlier posted closing hours than the drive-through.
cards.short_summary: A McElroy Road location with a 24-hour drive-through.
cards.evidence_claim: McDonald’s official location page lists the drive-through at 110 W McElroy Road as open 24 hours daily.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists drive-through hours as 24 hours daily; posted restaurant/lobby hours run 6 AM–midnight.

cards.title: Del Taco
cards.subtitle: 208 N Perkins Rd, Stillwater
cards.notes: Plan around the posted late closing time and use the official order-ahead option if it suits your trip. Weekend hours extend later.
cards.short_summary: A Perkins Road stop open into the early morning.
cards.evidence_claim: Del Taco’s official location page lists 2 AM closing most days and 3 AM closing on Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official hours: 10 AM–2 AM Sunday–Thursday and 10 AM–3 AM Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: Raising Cane's on Perkins
cards.subtitle: 317 N Perkins Rd, Stillwater
cards.notes: Use the official location page to choose dine-in or drive-through timing. Dine-in posting extends later than the drive-through.
cards.short_summary: A Perkins Road chicken-finger restaurant with late posted service.
cards.evidence_claim: Raising Cane’s official location page labels this restaurant Late Night and lists dine-in through 2 AM or 3:30 AM, depending on day.
cards.access_notes: Official dine-in hours: 10 AM–2 AM Sunday–Thursday and 10 AM–3:30 AM Friday–Saturday; verify before travel.

cards.title: Pickleman's Gourmet Cafe
cards.subtitle: 321 S Washington St, Stillwater
cards.notes: Head to Washington Avenue for a late sandwich, pizza, soup, or salad stop. The official page lists later Friday and Saturday hours.
cards.short_summary: A Washington Avenue café open until midnight or later.
cards.evidence_claim: Pickleman’s official Stillwater page lists midnight closing Sunday–Thursday and 2 AM closing Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official hours: 10 AM–midnight Sunday–Thursday and 10 AM–2 AM Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: Coney Island
cards.subtitle: 223 S Washington St, Stillwater
cards.notes: Check the day before walking over, then order from the restaurant counter rather than relying on adjacent venue hours. Late service is Thursday through Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A Washington Street restaurant with late Thursday–Saturday hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Coney Island’s official page lists restaurant hours until 2 AM on Thursday, Friday, and Saturday.
cards.source_title: Coney Island Stillwater — Rooftop and Hours
cards.access_notes: Official restaurant hours list 11 AM–2 AM Thursday–Saturday; Monday–Wednesday and Sunday close at 9 PM.

cards.title: Golden Chick
cards.subtitle: 116 E McElroy Rd, Stillwater
cards.notes: Use this McElroy Road location for a later Friday or Saturday meal. Its official page also lists online ordering and delivery.
cards.short_summary: A chicken restaurant with midnight hours on Fridays and Saturdays.
cards.evidence_claim: Golden Chick’s official Stillwater page lists Friday and Saturday hours from 10:30 AM to midnight.
cards.access_notes: Official hours list midnight closing Friday and Saturday; other listed days close at 11 PM.

cards.title: Chipotle Mexican Grill
cards.subtitle: 415 E Hall of Fame Ave, Stillwater
cards.notes: Use the Hall of Fame Avenue restaurant for an evening pickup or meal. The official page provides both in-store pickup and delivery options.
cards.short_summary: A daily 11 PM option on Hall of Fame Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: Chipotle’s official Stillwater location page lists restaurant hours of 10:45 AM–11 PM every day.
cards.source_title: Chipotle Mexican Grill — 415 E Hall of Fame Ave
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists 10:45 AM–11 PM Monday through Sunday, with pickup and delivery available.

cards.title: Texas Roadhouse
cards.subtitle: 2000 N Perkins Rd, Stillwater
cards.notes: Check the official waitlist or to-go page before making the longer Perkins Road trip. Friday and Saturday have the latest listed closing time.
cards.short_summary: A full-service Perkins Road option open until 11 PM on weekends.
cards.evidence_claim: Texas Roadhouse’s official Stillwater page lists 11 PM closing on Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official hours list 3 PM–11 PM Friday and 11 AM–11 PM Saturday; other listed days close at 10 PM.

boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named OSU locations for studying, making, moving, viewing art, and spending time with campus community resources.

cards.title: Start at the Student Union
cards.subtitle: 301 Student Union · campus services, dining, and events
cards.notes: Use the building map to orient yourself, then pair a practical errand with campus events, dining, or a meeting in the same stop.
cards.short_summary: A central campus building that combines services, events, dining, and gathering space.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU says the Student Union provides campus resources, facilities, services, and conveniences, and hosts diverse campus activities.
cards.access_notes: Check the Union's published hours and building map before visiting.

cards.title: See the OSU Esports Arena
cards.subtitle: Student Union · gaming and production space
cards.notes: Review the arena’s visitor information before going, then use its listed PCs and production features for a planned gaming or media session.
cards.short_summary: A 1,690-square-foot Student Union arena with PCs, a Twitch station, and a green screen.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU describes the arena as having 40 high-powered PCs, a Twitch station, a green screen, and learning partnerships tied to esports.
cards.source_title: OSU Esports Arena | Oklahoma State University
cards.access_notes: Confirm current access procedures and availability with OSU Esports.

cards.title: Set up at Edmon Low Library
cards.subtitle: Campus library · study rooms and research help
cards.notes: Choose a study-room option or research service from the library site, and check the daily hours before building your work session.
cards.short_summary: OSU’s main library offers study rooms, research support, collections, and creation services.
cards.evidence_claim: The library lists study rooms, research services, resources, and library hours for Edmon Low Library.
cards.source_title: Edmon Low Library and Branch Libraries
cards.access_notes: Study rooms may require reservations; consult the library’s current room and hours pages.

cards.title: Make something in Heritage Arts Studio
cards.subtitle: Edmon Low Library, first floor · textile and sewing equipment
cards.notes: Reserve the first-floor studio and complete any required training before bringing a creative or course-related textile project to work on.
cards.short_summary: A reservable library studio supporting creative and academic textile work.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU Libraries says the Heritage Arts Studio provides sewing and textile-arts equipment and can be reserved by OSU students, staff, and faculty.
cards.source_title: Edmon Low Library and Branch Libraries
cards.access_notes: Reservations and training are required; eligibility is stated for OSU students, staff, and faculty.

cards.title: Take an art break at OSU Museum of Art
cards.subtitle: 720 S. Husband Street · exhibitions and programs
cards.notes: Check the active exhibition and Tuesday–Saturday hours, then give yourself time to look through the galleries without rushing between classes.
cards.short_summary: A Stillwater museum presenting exhibitions, programs, and public art connections.
cards.evidence_claim: The OSU Museum of Art states that admission to its exhibitions, events, and programs is always free.
cards.source_title: OSU Museum of Art | Oklahoma State University
cards.access_notes: Published hours are Tuesday–Saturday, 11 a.m.–4 p.m.; verify holiday or business-hour changes before visiting.

cards.title: Walk through The Botanic Garden at OSU
cards.subtitle: OSU Stillwater · gardens and horticulture displays
cards.notes: Use the garden’s current visitor guidance to plan a slower outdoor stop, and keep to designated areas while viewing seasonal plant displays.
cards.short_summary: An OSU garden site connecting horticulture, public learning, and outdoor exploration.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU maintains The Botanic Garden at OSU as a university garden and visitor resource.
cards.access_notes: Consult the garden’s visitor information for current access details and event-specific requirements.

cards.title: Pause beside Theta Pond
cards.subtitle: Between the Student Union and Greek Life · pond and footbridge
cards.notes: Take a walk or study break along the pond, photograph the bridges and fountains, and leave wildlife and water conditions undisturbed.
cards.short_summary: A historic campus pond used for walking, studying, photos, and observing ducks.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU Facilities Management identifies Theta Pond as a place students and visitors use for studying, walking, jogging, photos, and watching ducks.
cards.source_title: Theta Pond | Oklahoma State University Facilities Management
cards.access_notes: Follow posted wildlife guidance; OSU asks visitors not to introduce toxic objects into the pond.

cards.title: Move at the Colvin
cards.subtitle: 101 Colvin Center · recreation and fitness facilities
cards.notes: Check facility hours and membership eligibility, then choose a listed activity area such as the track, courts, pool, or fitness spaces.
cards.short_summary: A recreation center with courts, fitness areas, aquatics, an indoor track, and activity spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU lists courts, aquatics, a four-lane indoor track, fitness areas, lockers, and other recreation facilities at the Colvin.
cards.source_title: Colvin Recreation Center | Oklahoma State University
cards.access_notes: Access and use depend on current memberships, facility hours, and activity-area rules.

cards.title: Climb at the Colvin wall
cards.subtitle: Colvin Recreation Center · climbing and bouldering
cards.notes: Make a climbing reservation or ask Outdoor Adventure about belay instruction before arriving, especially if you need staff or equipment support.
cards.short_summary: A 25-foot climbing wall and bouldering area operated through OSU Outdoor Adventure.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU lists a 25-foot climbing wall and bouldering walls at the Colvin, with reservations and belay-class information through Outdoor Adventure.
cards.access_notes: Reservations, staff availability, and applicable fees should be confirmed with Outdoor Adventure.

cards.title: Plan a Challenge Course session
cards.subtitle: 1625 N. Western Road · Outdoor Adventure
cards.notes: Contact Outdoor Adventure to reserve a group session, then use the course’s documented games, obstacles, and problem-solving activities as a team activity.
cards.short_summary: A reservable Outdoor Adventure course for physical and mental group challenges.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU describes its Outdoor Adventure Challenge Course as a series of games, obstacles, and problem-solving activities and provides reservation contact details.
cards.access_notes: Reservations are required; published group rates and participant requirements apply.

boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten no-purchase places for a low-key outing in and around Oklahoma State University’s Stillwater campus.

cards.title: Browse the OSU Museum of Art
cards.subtitle: Postal Plaza Gallery, downtown Stillwater
cards.notes: Walk through the current exhibition at Postal Plaza Gallery, then use the gallery’s public parking instead of building a paid outing around it.
cards.short_summary: A free downtown art stop with rotating exhibitions.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU Museum of Art states that admission is free and exhibitions and programs are free.
cards.source_title: OSU Museum of Art press kit
cards.access_notes: Postal Plaza Gallery is at 720 S. Husband St.; verify current exhibition hours before visiting.

cards.title: See what’s up at Gardiner Gallery
cards.subtitle: Bartlett Center, OSU Stillwater campus
cards.notes: Stop in during weekday public hours to view the gallery’s current work, then use the visit as a starting point for a campus walk.
cards.short_summary: A campus gallery with free public exhibitions.
cards.evidence_claim: Gardiner Gallery of Art is free and open to the public Monday through Friday, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m.; its events are free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Gardiner Gallery of Art: 24 Hours of Wonder
cards.access_notes: Located at 108 Bartlett Center; closed Sundays, university holidays, and home game days.

cards.title: Make a library lap
cards.subtitle: Center of OSU’s Stillwater campus
cards.notes: Meet under the Grand Staircase, browse the named reading rooms, and settle into a listed study space without needing to buy anything.
cards.short_summary: A public campus building with named reading and study spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU Libraries identifies Edmon Low Library and lists its Grand Staircase, reading rooms, galleries, and study spaces; the library describes itself and its branches as public places.
cards.source_title: Edmon Low Library floor maps and study spaces
cards.access_notes: Use public areas respectfully; reservable study rooms are limited to students, staff, and faculty.

cards.title: Join a Science Café conversation
cards.subtitle: OSU campus event series
cards.notes: Check the upcoming schedule, bring a question, and stay for the discussion after the scientist’s short presentation.
cards.short_summary: A free public science-talk series with discussion.
cards.evidence_claim: Science Café OSU describes its events as free and open to the public, with a scientist presentation followed by discussion and questions.
cards.access_notes: Dates, locations, and speakers vary; confirm the next event on the series website.

cards.title: Catch the Stillwater Arts Festival
cards.subtitle: Prairie Arts Center, 1001 S. Duck St.
cards.notes: Plan for the festival dates, browse the community art and demonstrations, and focus on the no-cost exhibition and activity offerings.
cards.short_summary: A free public arts-festival outing when it returns.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU’s Prairie Arts Center announcement states that the Stillwater Arts Festival is free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Prairie Arts Center gearing up for 2025 Stillwater Arts Festival
cards.access_notes: This is an annual event; verify the current year’s dates and program before going.

cards.title: Take a Boomer Lake Park walk
cards.subtitle: Washington & Lakeview, Stillwater
cards.notes: Use the open park setting for a walk, conversation, or picnic with your own supplies; avoid activities that require a permit or rental.
cards.short_summary: A named City of Stillwater park for simple outdoor time.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Stillwater lists Boomer Lake Park among its parks and open spaces; its parks plan says drop-in use of basic park amenities should remain free.
cards.access_notes: Use ordinary drop-in park amenities only; confirm any special-use rules before planning an organized activity.

cards.title: Hang out at Couch Park
cards.subtitle: 1270 E. Alcott St., Stillwater
cards.notes: Bring a friend for the walking path, playground area, or picnic tables, and keep the visit to ordinary drop-in park use.
cards.short_summary: A city park with outdoor recreation spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Stillwater lists Couch Park as a park and describes drop-in outdoor basics such as open areas, playgrounds, trails, and picnic areas as free in its parks plan.
cards.access_notes: The city page describes playground access; pool and organized-facility activities are outside this free drop-in suggestion.

cards.title: Shoot around at Arrington Park
cards.subtitle: 3rd St. & Arrington Dr., Stillwater
cards.notes: Use the outdoor basketball court for a casual game, or meet under the small shelter and bring anything you need from home.
cards.short_summary: A neighborhood park with an outdoor basketball court.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Stillwater identifies the basketball court and playground as Arrington Park’s primary activities; the city parks plan says basic drop-in outdoor amenities should remain free.
cards.access_notes: For casual drop-in use only; do not treat the shelter as reserved unless you have confirmed its reservation rules.

cards.title: Walk the Sanborn Lake trail
cards.subtitle: W. Airport Rd., Stillwater
cards.notes: Follow the walking trail and pause for bird-watching from public areas; bring water and leave the lake and trail as you found them.
cards.short_summary: A lake-side walking and bird-watching stop.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit Stillwater describes Sanborn Lake Park’s hiking trail, walking trail, and bird-watching access, and labels the listing free.
cards.source_title: Visit Stillwater: Sanborn Lake Park & Sports Complex
cards.access_notes: Stay on public trail areas and check local conditions before visiting.

cards.title: Use the Strickland Park skate area
cards.subtitle: 313 N. Main St., Stillwater
cards.notes: Bring your own board, bike, or protective gear for a daytime session, or simply watch from the park’s public areas with your group.
cards.short_summary: A city park with a skate-park option.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Stillwater lists Strickland Park among its parks and open spaces; the city parks plan says drop-in use of basic amenities, including skate parks, should remain free.
cards.access_notes: Use protective gear and follow posted park rules; check for closures related to the planned ballfield renovation.

boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten distinct OSU study settings, including reservable library rooms, a designated silent area, and an Honors College lounge with stated access requirements.

cards.entity_name: The Library Underground Group Study Space
cards.title: Library Underground Group Study Space
cards.subtitle: Lower Level, Edmon Low Library
cards.notes: Head to the lower level when your group needs a designated group-study setting; use the floor map to orient yourself near Maps & Spatial Data.
cards.short_summary: A named lower-level group-study destination in Edmon Low Library.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU Libraries lists The Library Underground Group Study Space on the lower-level floor map.
cards.source_title: Floor Maps & Study Spaces | Edmon Low Library & Branch Libraries
cards.access_notes: Check current Edmon Low Library hours before visiting; no reservation requirement is stated for this mapped group-study space.

cards.title: Study Bar
cards.subtitle: First Floor, Edmon Low Library
cards.notes: Use the first-floor map to locate this designated study bar, then settle in near the library’s circulation and information services.
cards.short_summary: A map-listed study bar on Edmon Low Library’s first floor.
cards.evidence_claim: The OSU Libraries first-floor map identifies a Study Bar within its study spaces and group study rooms.
cards.source_title: 1st Floor | Edmon Low Library & Branch Libraries
cards.access_notes: Check current Edmon Low Library hours before visiting; the map does not state a reservation requirement for the Study Bar.

cards.title: Relax and Read
cards.subtitle: First Floor, Edmon Low Library
cards.notes: Choose this map-listed first-floor reading area for a change of pace, and use the nearby library services when you need research help.
cards.short_summary: A designated first-floor Relax and Read area in Edmon Low Library.
cards.evidence_claim: The OSU Libraries first-floor map lists Relax and Read among its study spaces and group study rooms.
cards.source_title: 1st Floor | Edmon Low Library & Branch Libraries
cards.access_notes: Check current Edmon Low Library hours before visiting; the map does not state a reservation requirement for this area.

cards.entity_name: Roy & Marian Holleman Foundation Study Room
cards.title: Roy & Marian Holleman Foundation Study Room
cards.subtitle: Room 109F, First Floor, Edmon Low Library
cards.notes: Reserve this named room online for focused individual work or a collaborative session, then check in at circulation within 15 minutes of your start.
cards.short_summary: A reservable named study room on Edmon Low Library’s first floor.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU’s first-floor map lists Room 109F as the Roy & Marian Holleman Foundation Study Room; library study rooms are reservable.
cards.source_title: Study Rooms | Edmon Low Library & Branch Libraries
cards.access_notes: Reserve online or through Circulation & Information; up to two reservations may be active, and check-in is due within 15 minutes.

cards.title: Maribeth Subramaniam Study Room
cards.subtitle: Room 109G, First Floor, Edmon Low Library
cards.notes: Book this named first-floor room when a contained work session suits your task; return its key promptly to circulation when you finish.
cards.short_summary: A reservable study room named for Maribeth Subramaniam.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU’s first-floor map lists Room 109G as the Maribeth Subramaniam Study Room, and the library identifies it as a featured study room.
cards.source_title: Study Rooms | Edmon Low Library & Branch Libraries
cards.access_notes: Reserve online or through Circulation & Information; keep conversation inside the room, lock it, and return the key after use.

cards.entity_name: H. Louise & H.E. “Ed” Cobb Study Room
cards.title: H. Louise & H.E. “Ed” Cobb Study Room
cards.subtitle: Room 202, Second Floor, Edmon Low Library
cards.notes: Reserve Room 202 for an individual or collaborative work block; plan your arrival so you can check in at the circulation desk on time.
cards.short_summary: A named second-floor reservable study room.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU Libraries lists Room 202, the H. Louise & H.E. “Ed” Cobb Study Room, on the second-floor map.
cards.source_title: 2nd Floor | Edmon Low Library & Branch Libraries
cards.access_notes: Library study rooms are reservable online or via Circulation & Information; reservations can be made up to three weeks ahead.

cards.title: Jessie Thatcher Bost Study Room
cards.subtitle: Room 227, Second Floor, Edmon Low Library
cards.notes: Use the second-floor map to find Room 227, then reserve ahead for a quiet study-room session and arrive before the reservation hold expires.
cards.short_summary: A named second-floor study room honoring Jessie Thatcher Bost.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU Libraries lists Room 227 as the Jessie Thatcher Bost Study Room on its second-floor map.
cards.source_title: 2nd Floor | Edmon Low Library & Branch Libraries
cards.access_notes: Library study rooms require reservation; an unchecked reservation may be cancelled 15 minutes after its start time.

cards.entity_name: Dick & Malinda Fisher Student Gathering & Study Space
cards.title: Dick & Malinda Fisher Student Gathering & Study Space
cards.subtitle: Third Floor, Edmon Low Library
cards.notes: Use this named third-floor gathering and study space when working alongside others; the floor map also places computers, printers, and books nearby.
cards.short_summary: A named third-floor gathering and study area in Edmon Low Library.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU Libraries lists the Dick & Malinda Fisher Student Gathering & Study Space on the third-floor map.
cards.source_title: Floor Maps & Study Spaces | Edmon Low Library & Branch Libraries
cards.access_notes: Check current Edmon Low Library hours before visiting; the map does not state a reservation requirement for this space.

cards.title: Silent Study Area
cards.subtitle: Fourth Floor South, Edmon Low Library
cards.notes: For a quieter reading or writing block, go to the south side of the fourth floor and follow library expectations for a silent study area.
cards.short_summary: A designated silent study area on Edmon Low Library’s fourth floor.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU Libraries identifies the Silent Study Area as a popular location on the fourth floor south of Edmon Low Library.
cards.source_title: Photo & Video Policy | Edmon Low Library & Branch Libraries
cards.access_notes: Check current Edmon Low Library hours before visiting; the official floor map labels the fourth floor a Silent Zone.

cards.title: Honors Lounge and Study Space
cards.subtitle: Basement, Old Central
cards.notes: Active Honors College students can use the basement lounge and computer lab; request the coded key fob if you need access beyond posted hours.
cards.short_summary: An Honors College lounge with workstations, Wi-Fi, and stated after-hours access.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU states that active Honors College students have access to the Old Central basement lounge and computer lab, which has twelve workstations.
cards.source_title: Lounge and Activity Room | Oklahoma State University
cards.access_notes: Restricted to active Honors College students; standard lounge and lab hours are Monday–Friday, 8 a.m.–5 p.m.; a coded key fob can provide 24-hour access.

boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented Oklahoma State rituals spanning Homecoming and Cowboy football game day.

cards.title: Pistol Pete
cards.subtitle: OSU’s Cowboy mascot tradition
cards.notes: Spot Pistol Pete at a public university or athletics event, and learn how students audition to portray the mascot.
cards.short_summary: A mascot tradition rooted in Frank Eaton’s image and carried by student performers.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU says students began using a likeness of Frank Eaton as a mascot around 1923; students have worn the current Pistol Pete head and garb since 1958.
cards.access_notes: Mascot appearances vary by event; use an official OSU event or athletics schedule before planning.

cards.title: The Waving Song
cards.subtitle: Orange-and-black game-day gesture
cards.notes: Listen for the Waving Song after a football score or an OSU victory, then join the one-arm rhythmic wave.
cards.short_summary: Fans stand and wave one arm in rhythm with a school song.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU Athletics says fans rise and wave one arm in rhythm with the Waving Song after football scores and after victories in other sports.
cards.access_notes: Occurs in connection with OSU athletics; confirm the event schedule and venue entry rules.

cards.title: America’s Greatest Homecoming
cards.subtitle: OSU’s annual Homecoming week
cards.notes: Use the official Homecoming schedule to choose a public event, then experience the orange-focused campus celebration.
cards.short_summary: A university Homecoming tradition that groups several campus and community events.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU Athletics identifies its Homecoming week as “America’s Greatest Homecoming” and describes a range of activities across campus life.
cards.access_notes: Dates and public access change annually; consult current official Homecoming information.

cards.title: Walkaround House Decorations
cards.subtitle: Homecoming in OSU’s Greek neighborhood
cards.notes: During Homecoming, view the Greek house decorations on the announced Walkaround route and follow event guidance.
cards.short_summary: A Homecoming viewing tradition centered on elaborate house decorations.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU Athletics describes Walkaround as a Homecoming event with city streets closed around a block party centered on Homecoming decorations.
cards.access_notes: Street closures, route, and access are event-specific; review the current official Homecoming schedule.

cards.title: Hester Street Painting
cards.subtitle: Homecoming street-painting tradition
cards.notes: Look for the official Homecoming street-painting opportunity and add encouragement only where event organizers permit it.
cards.short_summary: A Homecoming practice of painting spirit messages along Hester Street.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU Athletics names street painting among the university’s Homecoming traditions and identifies Hester Street Painting as part of the celebration.
cards.access_notes: Participate only during the officially scheduled event and follow organizers’ materials and location instructions.

cards.title: Orange Ambiance
cards.subtitle: Homecoming residence-hall display
cards.notes: Walk through campus during the announced Homecoming display period and view the residence-hall orange decorations from public areas.
cards.short_summary: Residence halls add orange visual displays during Homecoming week.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU Athletics lists Orange Ambiance among the traditions that make up its Homecoming week.
cards.access_notes: Display timing and locations vary; stay in public areas and check current Homecoming information.

cards.title: Homecoming & Hoops
cards.subtitle: Homecoming event at Gallagher-Iba Arena
cards.notes: Check the Homecoming program for Homecoming & Hoops and follow the arena’s current entry and bag policies.
cards.short_summary: A Homecoming program linking Cowboy football spirit with basketball.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU Athletics includes Homecoming & Hoops among the longstanding activities of its Homecoming week.
cards.access_notes: Event timing, tickets, and venue access are set annually; verify with official OSU Athletics information.

cards.title: Sea of Orange Parade
cards.subtitle: Homecoming parade in Stillwater
cards.notes: Find the current parade route and watch from a permitted public viewing area during OSU’s Homecoming weekend.
cards.short_summary: A Homecoming parade that brings orange spirit into Stillwater.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU Athletics lists the Sea of Orange Parade as a Homecoming-week activity and describes the parade tradition in Stillwater.
cards.access_notes: Route, start time, and street restrictions vary each year; rely on current official event details.

cards.entity_name: Bullet and the OSU Spirit Rider
cards.title: Bullet and the Spirit Rider
cards.subtitle: Football touchdown run tradition
cards.notes: At a Cowboy football game, watch for Bullet and the Spirit Rider’s touchdown run toward the 30-yard line.
cards.short_summary: A horse-and-rider tradition connected to Cowboy football touchdowns.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU Athletics says the Spirit Rider program began in 1984 and that the rider and Bullet run to the 30-yard line after a touchdown.
cards.access_notes: This occurs at football games; observe from designated spectator areas and follow stadium rules.

cards.title: The Walk
cards.subtitle: Cowboy football team arrival
cards.notes: Arrive at the announced pregame time and cheer from the public route as the team heads down Hester Street to the stadium.
cards.short_summary: A pregame procession that brings the football team, band, and spirit groups together.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU Athletics says The Walk began in 2001 and has the football team walk down Hester Street to Boone Pickens Stadium with the marching band and spirit squad.
cards.access_notes: Pregame timing depends on kickoff; confirm the current game-day schedule and keep clear of the procession route.

boards.title: Your First Weekend at Oklahoma State University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-key first-weekend route that starts on campus, follows OSU landmarks and ends with a Stillwater art-and-garden outing.

cards.title: Start with the Student Union
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · 301 Student Union
cards.notes: Use the information desk and building as your starting point, then check the current-hours page before relying on a specific service.
cards.short_summary: Begin at the central campus hub.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU lists the Student Union at 301 Student Union and publishes building and service hours online.
cards.access_notes: Hours may change for holidays, breaks, game days, weather and special events; verify the live hours page.

cards.title: Find an involvement starting point
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · 232 Student Union
cards.notes: Stop by Campus Life to ask about organizations, volunteering, peer mentoring and upcoming events that fit your interests.
cards.short_summary: Turn first-weekend curiosity into a next step.
cards.evidence_claim: Campus Life says it offers opportunities for student organizations, volunteering, peer mentoring and events; its office is at 232 Student Union.
cards.source_title: About Us | Campus Life | Oklahoma State University
cards.access_notes: Campus Life lists office hours as Monday–Friday, 8 a.m.–5 p.m.; use CampusLink outside those office hours.

cards.title: Take a Library Lawn reset
cards.subtitle: Friday late afternoon · central campus
cards.notes: Walk through the formal garden and pause on the lawn; save the spot as an easy outdoor meet-up point between campus stops.
cards.short_summary: A campus green space beside the library.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU’s self-guided tour identifies Library Lawn as a gathering place for studying, games, breaks and activities throughout the year.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor setting; check weather and campus event activity before planning a long stop.

cards.title: Learn your library landmarks
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · Edmon Low Library
cards.notes: Find a study floor and note the Creative Studios for future projects; reserve a group room later if you need one.
cards.short_summary: Six floors of study space and creative tools.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU says Edmon Low Library has six floors of study space, 25 reservable group study rooms and Creative Studios; it operates 24/5 in fall and spring.
cards.source_title: Edmon Low Library | Oklahoma State University
cards.access_notes: The 24/5 schedule applies during fall and spring semesters; confirm current library access and service hours before visiting.

cards.title: Walk to Theta Pond
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning · campus pond and bridge
cards.notes: Take the path around the pond, pause under a shady tree and keep a respectful distance from the ducks and geese.
cards.short_summary: A historic campus pond for a quiet walk.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU describes Theta Pond as a setting for relaxing, talking with a friend, photographs and watching ducks and geese.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor destination; stay on paths and follow posted campus guidance around water and wildlife.

cards.title: Spot the Cowboy Boot Topiary
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning · southwest corner of Theta Pond
cards.notes: Continue to the southwest corner of Theta Pond and frame a photo from the path without stepping into planted areas.
cards.short_summary: A seven-foot campus topiary shaped like a boot.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU reports that the Cowboy Boot Topiary stands at Theta Pond’s southwest corner near University and Monroe streets and was created from six plant types.
cards.access_notes: View from public campus walkways; protect the planted topiary by staying outside landscaped beds.

cards.title: Meet the horse sculptures
cards.subtitle: Saturday midday · east side of the Student Union
cards.notes: Circle back to the Union’s east side and take time to look closely at Marrita Black’s mare-and-colt sculpture from the plaza.
cards.short_summary: A named public-art stop outside the Union.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU’s public-art map places Marrita Black’s Proud and Immortal on the east side of the Student Union at 110 S. Hester Street.

cards.title: See DNA IV at McKnight
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · McKnight Center plaza
cards.notes: Walk to the north side of the McKnight Center and view Bill Barrett’s bronze sculpture before checking the venue’s current calendar.

cards.evidence_claim: OSU identifies DNA IV as a permanent Bill Barrett sculpture at the McKnight Center and part of the OSU Museum of Art collection.

cards.title: Make an art-museum stop downtown
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · 720 S. Husband Street
cards.notes: Choose a current exhibition, give yourself time to look closely, and use the museum’s photography guidance before taking pictures.
cards.short_summary: A free downtown OSU museum visit.
cards.evidence_claim: The OSU Museum of Art lists free admission, Tuesday–Saturday gallery hours of 11 a.m.–4 p.m, and its address at 720 S. Husband Street.
cards.access_notes: Admission is always free. Gallery hours are Tuesday–Saturday, 11 a.m.–4 p.m.; closed Sunday and Monday.

cards.evidence_claim: OSU describes The Botanic Garden as a 100-acre site with walking trails and display gardens, open 6 a.m.–8 p.m. March through October.
